summary: Set/get positive zoom factor using Electron WebContents zoom state.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.factor: zoom percent divided by 100; must be > 0
semantics.effect: changes page zoom according to current zoom mode

tests.name: factor
tests.expected_behavior: returns current factor near 1.5 according to Electron
